name: std-modal-editor
description: UI substrate: modal keyboard editing over any editable CodeBlock. The topology is fixed (NORMAL / INSERT / VISUAL / OPERATOR_PENDING / COMMAND) and every binding is config: mode-entry keys, motions, operators, ex-commands, the digit table that accumulates a repeat count, and the per-mode captured-key table the host's keyboard router reads. Vim ships as the default flavor; a Kakoune/Helix binding is the same topology with different config, never a fork. Emits are the mechanical vocabulary an editable CodeBlock listens to (SET_MODE / MOTION / OPERATE / INSERT_TEXT) plus one neutral EX_COMMAND for a buffered ':' line — std names no host command; a realization maps EX_COMMAND.name onto its own host vocabulary.

schema.name: std-modal-editor
schema.description: UI substrate: modal keyboard editing over any editable CodeBlock. The topology is fixed (NORMAL / INSERT / VISUAL / OPERATOR_PENDING / COMMAND) and every binding is config: mode-entry keys, motions, operators, ex-commands, the digit table that accumulates a repeat count, and the per-mode captured-key table the host's keyboard router reads. Vim ships as the default flavor; a Kakoune/Helix binding is the same topology with different config, never a fork. Emits are the mechanical vocabulary an editable CodeBlock listens to (SET_MODE / MOTION / OPERATE / INSERT_TEXT) plus one neutral EX_COMMAND for a buffered ':' line — std names no host command; a realization maps EX_COMMAND.name onto its own host vocabulary.

emits.description: Mode + caret instruction for the editor surface (bar | block). Also the fact a realization reads to drive a mode indicator.
Move the caret (or extend the selection in VISUAL) by a closed motion name, `count` times.
Apply a config-declared operator (delete | yank | change) over the range a motion describes; `line` for doubled operators, `selection` in VISUAL.
Insert literal text at the caret (e.g. the newline `o` opens before entering INSERT).
A buffered ':' line resolved through config.exCommands. `name` is a neutral config-declared string; a realization maps it onto its host's command vocabulary.

events.name: Key
events.description: One physical keydown, delivered by the host's keyboard router. The host decides preventDefault from config.keymap; this trait only reads key + editorId.

events.name: Set Mode
events.description: Mode + caret instruction for the editor surface (bar | block). Also the fact a realization reads to drive a mode indicator.

events.name: Motion
events.description: Move the caret (or extend the selection in VISUAL) by a closed motion name, `count` times.

events.name: Operate
events.description: Apply a config-declared operator (delete | yank | change) over the range a motion describes; `line` for doubled operators, `selection` in VISUAL.

events.name: Insert Text
events.description: Insert literal text at the caret (e.g. the newline `o` opens before entering INSERT).

events.name: Ex Command
events.description: A buffered ':' line resolved through config.exCommands. `name` is a neutral config-declared string; a realization maps it onto its host's command vocabulary.

visualKey.label: Enter VISUAL
visualKey.description: Key that switches NORMAL to VISUAL; motions then extend the selection and an operator acts on it.

commandKey.label: Enter COMMAND
commandKey.description: Key that switches NORMAL to COMMAND and starts buffering an ex-command line.

appendKey.label: Enter INSERT after the caret
appendKey.description: Key that nudges the caret one column right, then switches to INSERT.

motions.label: Motion keys
motions.description: Keys recognized in NORMAL, VISUAL and OPERATOR_PENDING, mapped to the closed motion vocabulary the editor surface understands.

operators.label: Operator keys
operators.description: Keys that arm OPERATOR_PENDING, mapped to the operator name carried on OPERATE. Pressing the same key again operates on the whole line.

exCommands.label: Ex-commands
exCommands.description: Buffered COMMAND-mode lines (typed after ':') mapped to a neutral command name carried on EX_COMMAND.

keymap.label: Captured keys per mode
keymap.description: The declared key set the host's keyboard router reads synchronously to decide preventDefault, keyed by this trait's current state name. A key not listed reaches the underlying textarea untouched. Keep in sync with the other knobs.

digits.label: Count digits
digits.description: Digit keys accumulated into a repeat count before a motion or operator fires; each digit's integer value is a lookup because the language has no string-to-int operator.

openLineKey.label: Open a line below and insert
openLineKey.description: Key that moves to line end, inserts a newline, then switches to INSERT.

insertKey.label: Enter INSERT before the caret
insertKey.description: Key that switches NORMAL to INSERT with the caret unchanged.
